data.description:
Salary up to: Competitive Platform Engineer Developer Experience Team London / Hybrid | Mid level

Help our engineers spend more time building great experiences for our restaurant teams and customers. As a mid-level Platform Engineer in our Developer Experience team, you’ll build the tools, automation and cloud foundations that make software easier to develop, deploy and run at Nando’s.

The role

You’ll own defined platform improvements from implementation through to release and ongoing support, with guidance from experienced colleagues when you need it. Working closely with engineering teams, you’ll turn everyday frustrations into practical, reusable solutions and help shape an internal platform that developers want to use.

What you will do

  • Work with engineers to understand where development and deployment become difficult, and translate their feedback into useful platform improvements.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure on Google Cloud

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, develop, and maintain Python-based web applications using the Flask framework.
  • Create responsive and visually appealing user interfaces using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
  • Develop and integrate RESTful services to support seamless communication between frontend and backend systems.
  • Containerise applications using Docker for streamlined deployment and scalability.
  • Deploy and manage applications on AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Implement continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using Jenkins.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ensure code quality, performance, and security through rigorous testing and code reviews.
  • Utilise version control systems, particularly Git, for managing the codebase and collaboration.

EXPERIENCE / REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s
